not_found: Isotope shifts 123Sb-121Sb: Sobolewski, Bouazza, Windholz, Kwela, "Isotope shifts in Sb I", J. Opt. Soc. Am. B 33, 1921 (2016) measured eight lines (UV-NIR); only the abstract could be opened (https://opg.optica.org/josab/abstract.cfm?uri=josab-33-9-1921), it prints no numbers. The COLLAPS 217.6 nm isotope shifts were not found in the papers opened.

Hyperfine constants of 123Sb for the 5p3 2D, 2P levels and of both isotopes for most 5p2 6s / 5d levels: Hassini et al., J. Opt. Soc. Am. B 5, 2060 (1988) and Sobolewski, Bouazza, Kwela, Eur. Phys. J. D 70, 20 (2016) could not be opened (publisher access); only the values quoted in Lechner et al. 2023 and Liu et al. 2023 are recorded.
Measured lifetimes of the metastable 5p3 2D°3/2,5/2 and 2P°1/2,3/2 levels: none located (theory only).

Measured (not calculated) branching fractions or transition probabilities for the 5p3 - 5p2 6s lines: none opened; Guern & Lotrian, J. Quant. Spectrosc. Radiat. Transfer 24, 133 (1980) and Gonzalez, Ortiz, Campos, JQSRT 57, 825 (1997) are cited by Hartman et al. but were not opened.
Precise (laser / frequency-comb) transition frequencies: none located.
Lines used for laser cooling or clocks: none located for neutral Sb.
conflicts: 5p2(3P)6s 2P1/2 (46991.058): 3.7(2) ns (Hartman 2010, laser) vs 5.2(5) and 5.5(7) ns (delayed coincidence, Osherovich & Tezikov 1977 - both values are printed with the same footnote in Hartman's Table II).
5p2(3P)6s 4P1/2 (43249.337): 5.3(2) ns (Hartman 2010) vs 4.3(4) ns (Osherovich & Tezikov 1977); beam-foil 5.0(4) ns agrees.

5p2(1D)6s 2D3/2 and 2D5/2: only old measurements exist (3.7(4), 3.8(3) ns, beam-foil); Hartman's own MCDHF calculation gives 8.2 and 5.5 ns, so the calculated A values / branching fractions recorded for these two upper levels are less reliable than for the others. The sum of the three recorded theory A values for 2D3/2 corresponds to 8.3 ns (derived).

121Sb ground-state A: -299.034(4) MHz (Fernando et al. 1960, atomic beam; confirmed by Lechner 2023: -299.0(3)) vs -305.79(21) MHz printed as 'Exp. 1988' (Hassini et al.) in Table XI of Liu et al. arXiv:2306.15885; the atomic-beam value is kept.
121Sb 5p3 2D°3/2 B: -561(6) MHz (Hassini 1988) vs -360(89) MHz (Buchholz 1978), both as quoted by Liu et al. 2023; A values agree (565(7) vs 563(15)).
121Sb 6s 4P3/2: A = 523.8(5), B = -471(2) MHz (Lechner 2023) vs 519(6), -480(15) MHz (Hassini 1988): consistent within the older uncertainty.
notes: All transition A_s and branching values are CALCULATED (MCDHF, Hartman et al. 2010, Table III) and marked method 'theory'; they are not measurements. Rows flagged in the paper as affected by convergence problems (upper levels 5d 4P1/2, 4D1/2, 4D5/2) were left out. Lifetimes with method 'experiment' are the laser measurements of Hartman et al.; those with method 'compilation' are older beam-foil / delayed-coincidence values read in Hartman's Table II (originals not opened). Hyperfine constants of the 5p3 2D, 2P levels are for 121Sb and are second-hand (read in Liu et al. 2023, units MHz as printed there). Wavelengths in labels are those printed by Hartman et al. (air above 200 nm, vacuum below). Lechner et al. give A and B for both hyperfine-split levels of the 217.6 nm line for 112-133Sb; only the stable isotopes are recorded here.
